name: Telegram Bridge
description: Connect a private Telegram bot to saved Mocu agents. Send and receive files as well as messages; Telegram attachments are downloaded locally and can be routed to the selected agent.

commands.title: Start Telegram bot listener
commands.description: Start the Telegram long-poll listener so the configured, authorized private-chat user can message saved Mocu agents. The listener continues in the background while Mocu is open. Run this after installing/configuring the extension or after restarting Mocu.

commands.title: Stop Telegram bot listener
commands.description: Stop the Telegram long-poll listener without uninstalling the extension.

commands.title: Telegram bot status
commands.description: Check whether the Telegram listener is running and see its configured chat ID without revealing the bot token.

commands.title: List saved Mocu agents
commands.description: List the user's saved Mocu agents so you can choose an agent to address from Telegram.

commands.title: Send an agent message to Telegram
commands.description: Send a message from a saved Mocu agent to the configured Telegram private chat. Include the exact saved agent name or agent ID and the message; the extension labels the Telegram message with that agent's name so the user can reply to it with /reply.

commands.title: Send a file to Telegram
commands.description: Send a local file to the configured Telegram private chat. Input must include filePath (an absolute local file path) and the exact saved agent name or ID in agentName; optional caption adds context. Files up to 50 MB are supported.

config.label: Telegram bot token
config.description: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token here. Keep this token secret.

config.label: Allowed Telegram private chat ID
config.description: The numeric ID of your private Telegram chat (for example, ask @userinfobot). Only messages from this exact private chat are processed; group chats and all other users are ignored.

config.label: Telegram download folder
config.description: Absolute local folder where incoming Telegram files are saved. Defaults to the current user's .mocu/telegram-downloads folder.
